summary: All 6 phases of the topic-normalization plan completed and verified. Introduced a single canonical normalize_topic() helper (lowercase kebab-case) enforced at the manage-topics.sh write chokepoint and routed through both generate-task-order.sh renderers (.claude core extension source + deployed mirror + .opencode render-side mirror), fixing the origin bug where the dependency tree rendered flat for any non-lowercase topic. Added an autonomous-context deterministic-default directive to topic-assignment-pattern.md and documented the topic/active_topics schema fields in state-management-schema.md. Phase 6 confirmed zero migration was needed: this repository's existing topic data (3 active_topics entries, 3 active_projects[].topic values) was already a fixed point under normalize_topic, and generate-todo.sh regenerated specs/TODO.md cleanly with no topic-data mutation to specs/state.json.

verification_evidence.phase_1_manage_topics: Fixture test: add 'Modal Logic' -> stores 'modal-logic'; repeated add with 'modal_logic'/'modal-logic' variants are idempotent no-ops; set stores 'code-hygiene' for 'Code Hygiene'; validate 'Modal Logic' exits 0. Real specs/state.json confirmed untouched.
verification_evidence.phase_2_origin_renderer: Fixture test: 4-task chain (1->2->3->4) with topics 'Modal Logic' (x3) and 'modal-logic' (x1) rendered as exactly ONE '### Modal Logic' heading with 3 '└─' indented lines -- origin bug fixed, no duplicate heading.
verification_evidence.phase_3_opencode_mirror: Fixture test: .claude and .opencode renderers produced byte-identical Grouped-by-Topic sections (diff clean) against the same fixture.
verification_evidence.phase_4_autonomous_directive: grep -n orchestrator_mode topic-assignment-pattern.md returns the new directive naming the deterministic default and forbidding AskUserQuestion.
verification_evidence.phase_5_schema_docs: grep -n active_topics and grep -n topic against state-management-schema.md confirm both fields documented with canonical-form note.
verification_evidence.phase_6_local_verification: Fixed-point loop: 0 non-canonical values found in live specs/state.json. generate-todo.sh exit 0, no diff to specs/TODO.md. git diff specs/state.json clean of topic-data mutations.
verification_evidence.no_task_number_leakage: Repo-wide grep across all 6 modified deliverable files for 'task 859' returned clean.

follow_ups_flagged: .opencode/ write-side topic-assignment parity (manage-topics.sh equivalent, topic-assignment-pattern.md equivalent, /task topic step) remains out of scope and is a recommended follow-up task, flagged in a script-header comment in .opencode/scripts/generate-task-order.sh and in the execution summary's Notes section.
